sentences.content: I mean Chandler's birthday is even before mine!

sentences.content: Surprise!

sentences.content: Wow! This is so great!

sentences.chinese: 哇！这真是太棒了！

sentences.content: Look at all these cups!

sentences.chinese: 看看这些杯子！

sentences.content: This is so weird.

sentences.chinese: 这太奇怪了。

sentences.content: I was in charge of cups.

sentences.content: Oh, okay, not so weird.

sentences.chinese: 哦，好吧，也没那么奇怪。

sentences.content: Listen man, uh, I'm sorry the audition didn't go so well.
sentences.english: Listen man , uh , I'm sorry the audition didn't go so well
sentences.chinese: 听着老兄，呃，我很抱歉试镜不太顺利。

sentences.content: Yeah right!
sentences.english: Yeah right !
sentences.chinese: 得了吧！

sentences.content: No really, I-I am Joey! I feel bad!
sentences.english: No really , I-I am Joey ! I feel bad !
sentences.chinese: 不，真的，我-我是Joey！我很难过！

sentences.content: Yeah? Well look Ross, you don't have to. Okay?
sentences.english: Yeah ? Well look Ross , you don't have to . Okay ?
sentences.chinese: 是吗？好吧Ross，你不必这样。行了吧？

sentences.content: It's not your fault I suck.
sentences.english: It's not your fault I suck
sentences.chinese: 我这么差劲不是你的错。

sentences.content: I mean what kind of an actor can't even say, "Hmm, noodle soup."
sentences.english: I mean what kind of an actor can't even say ," Hmm , noodle soup ."
sentences.chinese: 我是说，什么样的演员连“嗯，面条汤”都说不出来。

sentences.content: Yeah y'know what?
sentences.english: Yeah y'know what ?
sentences.chinese: 你知道吗？

sentences.content: Maybe-maybe you didn't mess up your audition because you suck,
sentences.english: Maybe-maybe you didn't mess up your audition because you suck
sentences.chinese: 也许——也许你搞砸试镜并不是因为你太差劲,

sentences.content: maybe you messed up because you care
sentences.english: maybe you messed up because you care
sentences.chinese: 或许你搞砸了是因为在乎

sentences.content: more about uh, your godson.
sentences.english: more about uh , your godson
sentences.chinese: 更多关于，嗯，你教子的事。

sentences.content: What you do mean?
sentences.english: What you do mean ?
sentences.chinese: 你这是什么意思？

sentences.content: I think, sub-consciously...
sentences.english: I think , sub-consciously ..
sentences.chinese: 我想，潜意识里...

sentences.content: Wait-whoa-whoa, you lost me.
sentences.english: Wait-whoa-whoa , you lost me
sentences.chinese: 等等——哇哦——哇哦，我没听懂。

sentences.content: I think on some level,
sentences.english: I think on some level
sentences.chinese: 我认为在某种程度上，

sentences.content: you-you sabotaged your own audition
sentences.english: you-you sabotaged your own audition
sentences.chinese: 你——你搞砸了自己的试镜

sentences.content: so that Ben would get the part.
sentences.english: so that Ben would get the part
sentences.chinese: 这样Ben就能得到这个角色了。

sentences.content: Well, you're way sounds a lot better than mine.
sentences.english: Well , you're way sounds a lot better than mine
sentences.chinese: 嗯，你的方法听起来比我的好多了。

sentences.content: - Yeah. Yeah! It's not that I'm a bad actor... - No!

sentences.chinese: 是啊。是啊！不是说我演技差...——才不是呢！

sentences.content: No, it's just ah, I care so damn much about little Ben
sentences.english: No , it's just ah , I care so damn much about little Ben
sentences.chinese: 不，只是啊，我他妈太在乎小Ben了

sentences.content: that uh, it was more important to see him succeed.
sentences.english: that uh , it was more important to see him succeed
sentences.chinese: 更重要的是看到他成功。

sentences.content: There you go. Thank you!
sentences.english: There you go . Thank you !
sentences.chinese: 给你。谢谢！

sentences.content: - Thank you! So, did-did he get it? - No.
sentences.english: - Thank you ! So , did-did he get it ? - No
sentences.chinese: - 谢谢！那——那他拿到了吗？- 没有。

sentences.chinese: 哦，你好！请问Rachel Green在这里吗？

sentences.content: Okay, great.
sentences.english: Okay , great
sentences.chinese: 好的，太好了。
